PLAN "12-Week Fat Loss & Glycaemic Control Programme"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY private

GOALS
  GOAL primary fat_loss:
    name "Reduce body fat while improving insulin sensitivity"
  GOAL secondary general_health:
    name "Lower HbA1c toward sub-6.5 range"
  GOAL secondary strength:
    name "Build lean mass to improve glucose disposal"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation & Metabolic Priming" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Full Body A - Movement Quality":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          cat_cow 1m
          bird_dog 2x10 rest 30 seconds
          glute_bridge 2x12 rest 30 seconds
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          cable_row 3x12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x30 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 10m
          hamstring_stretch 1m
          chest_stretch 1m
      DAY Tuesday training 35m "Zone 2 Cardio":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          cycling 25m rpe 5
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
          quad_stretch 1m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Full Body B - Movement Quality":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          hip_circles 1m
          dead_bug 2x10 rest 30 seconds
          scapular_retraction 2x12 rest 30 seconds
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 10m
          hip_flexor_stretch 1m
          lat_stretch 1m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Full Body C - Movement Quality":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          leg_swings 1m
          inchworm 2x6 rest 30 seconds
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          incline_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          seated_row 3x12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x20 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 10m
          figure_four_stretch 1m
          shoulder_stretch 1m
      DAY Saturday training 40m "Post-Meal Walk + Mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 30m rpe 4
        cooldown:
          child_pose 2m
          spinal_twist 1m
